mechanism: row-to-core balance / four-wave scheduling for widest rows
hypothesis: For row widths above 32768 elements, four scheduling waves may expose smaller row groups to the cores and reduce long per-block tails while preserving the balanced contiguous row partition.
change: For rowWidth > 32768 only, multiply the requested block count by four when safe, cap it at rowCount, and retain the final uint32 launch bound. Other widths keep one wave. No row ownership arithmetic or kernel math changed.
